text_koine: ἡ γλαῦξ ἐξέρχεται ἐκ τῆς οἰκίας.
artist_notes: the frame does not show the whole house, but only the door; the house is at a slight angle; owl is in the door frame mid-stride going to the right; we see owls face

text_koine: ἡ γλαῦξ πέτεται πρὸς τὴν σχολήν.
artist_notes: the house is on the left and school on the right, with many fields and hills and paths in between; this is a wide angle shot with the school and house in the distance; owl is flying from the left to the right

text_koine: ἡ γλαῦξ ἀφικνεῖ ἐπί τὴν σχολήν.
text_english: The owl arrives ontop of the school.
artist_notes: Owl should be sitting on top of the school in a relaxed pose.

text_koine: ἡ γλαῦξ εἰσέρχεται εἰς τὴν σχολήν.
artist_notes: owl is partially in the school room door; only his back is visible to the audience because he is looking into the school.

text_koine: ἡ γλαὺξ κάθηται παρὰ τῇ τραπέζῃ
text_english: The owl sits at the desk

text_koine: ἡ γλαῦξ μανθάνει τοὺς ἀριθμούς τε καὶ τὰ γράμματα.
text_english: The owl learns the numbers and the letters.

text_koine: ἡ γλαῦξ παίζει μετὰ τῶν φίλων.
text_english: The owl plays with the friends.

text_koine: ἡ γλαῦξ ἐξέρχεται ἐκ τῆς σχολῆς.
artist_notes: We view the scene from the interior of the school; Owl is in the doorway and we only see his back because his is walking through the door to the outside.

text_koine: ἡ γλαῦξ πέτεται πρὸς τὴν οἰκίαν.
artist_notes: very wide angle shot with the house in the far distance on the left hand side; owl is in the foreground flying towards the house; we do not see owl's face because he is looking at the house in the distance

text_koine: ἡ γλαῦξ εἰσέρχεται εἰς τὴν οἰκίαν.
artist_notes: we view the scene from the exterior; owl is in the doorway entering the house; we only see his back

text_koine: ἡ γλαὺξ καθεύδει ἐν τῇ κλίνῃ.
text_english: The owl sleeps in the bed.
